overview_description.description: AYC Fund provides AI-driven quantitative trading services focused on digital asset markets. The company develops an HFT Grid Bot and related automation tools that connect to client-owned exchange accounts via API, executing crypto trading strategies without taking custody of funds. Its platform combines machine learning research, quantitative signal logic, and automated execution with configurable risk controls. AYC Fund also offers invite-only managed digital asset programs for qualified clients through dedicated investment vehicles. Additional tools include TradingView indicators, pump screening alerts, and safety engines that enforce predefined risk parameters.
